bounties.title: View edges
bounties.blurb: Dots far out to the sides and corners: eyes turned as far as they go.

bounties.title: Blinks and lids
bounties.blurb: Blinks, winks, squints and half-closed eyes.

bounties.title: Headset slips
bounties.blurb: Nudge the headset on your face, take it off and on: dots after each.

bounties.title: Glasses
bounties.blurb: The grid and the edges with glasses or inserts on.

bounties.title: Jumps and pursuit
bounties.blurb: A jumping dot, then one gliding on circles, lines and a figure eight.

bounties.title: Light changes
bounties.blurb: Dark to bright and back: pupils changing size.

bounties.title: Face moves
bounties.blurb: Smile, frown, yawn, talk and chew while looking at a dot.

bounties.title: Head turning
bounties.blurb: A dot fixed in the room while you turn your head.

bounties.title: Reading
bounties.blurb: Read a few paragraphs and look around freely.
